text:
Invitation declined

a•••@example.com declined their invitation to the admin area (role: Support). They have no admin access, and they can be invited again.

—
You get this email because you invited this person or you are a TipMe owner.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

Done without a second person

a•••@example.com took a serious admin action (Change a page’s fee) on their own, because nobody else was available to approve it. The admin audit log has their reason. If you didn’t expect this, check it now.

—
You get this email because you are a TipMe owner.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

A withdrawal freeze was released

a•••@example.com closed a reported account takeover, which releases its freeze. This recipient can withdraw again. The admin audit log has their reason. If you didn’t expect this, check it now.

—
You get this email because you are a TipMe owner.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

Your request has an outcome

Your request (Change a page’s fee) was approved and has run.

—
You get this email because you asked for this admin action.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

Waiting for a second person

a•••@example.com asked for a serious admin action (Change a page’s fee). Nothing has happened yet. Open Approvals in the admin area to see exactly what would change, and approve or reject it. It closes by itself after 24 hours.

—
You get this email because you hold the permission this action needs.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

No second person left

A staff change by a•••@example.com left nobody else to approve serious admin actions under these permissions: fees.manage,staff.manage. One person can now take those actions alone. The admin audit log has their reason. If you didn’t expect this, check it now.

—
You get this email because you are a TipMe owner.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

This email came through ZeptoMail

Open the link while signed in to TipMe ops to confirm the provider delivers mail.

Confirm this test: https://usetipme.xyz/ops/providers/confirm?ml=confirm_test#t=sample-token-sample-token-sample-token-0003

—
A TipMe staff member sent this test from the Providers page.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

Your sign-in email changed

Your TipMe account now signs in with a•••@example.com. This address no longer works for it.

If this wasn’t you, contact support@usetipme.xyz straight away.

—
You get this email because this was the sign-in address of a TipMe account.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

Someone is moving your account

A recovery was started to move your TipMe account to a•••@example.com. It happens in 24 hours.

If this wasn’t you, sign in now and cancel it in Settings.

Sign in and cancel: https://usetipme.xyz/dashboard/settings?ml=cancel_recovery

—
You get this email to help keep your account safe.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

Your account moved

Your TipMe account now signs in with a•••@example.com. Every device was signed out.

If this wasn’t you, contact support@usetipme.xyz straight away.

—
You get this email because a recovery of this TipMe account just finished.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

Recovery cancelled

A request to move this TipMe account to a•••@example.com was cancelled, because the account’s access changed. Its sign-in details stay as they were.

If you still need to recover it, contact support@usetipme.xyz.

—
You get this email because a recovery of this TipMe account was waiting.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

You have staff access

This account can now use the TipMe admin area. If you weren’t expecting this, reply to this email straight away.

—
You get this email when the staff access on your account changes.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

Your payment account needs attention

Our payment provider needs something from you. You may not be able to receive tips until it’s sorted.

Check your payment account: https://usetipme.xyz/dashboard/settings?ml=settings

—
You get this email when your payment account is restricted or needs information.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

Your page was paused

TipMe staff paused your page, so it isn’t taking new tips. Tips already on their way still settle. Reply to this email to find out more.

—
You get this email when staff pause your page.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

We removed your page’s cover

TipMe staff removed the cover from your page. Your page is still up and can take tips. You can choose another in Settings. Reply to this email to find out more.

Go to Settings: https://usetipme.xyz/dashboard/settings?ml=settings

—
You get this email when staff remove an image from your page.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

Your page is back

TipMe staff restored your page, and it can take tips again.

Go to your dashboard: https://usetipme.xyz/dashboard?ml=dashboard

—
You get this email when staff restore your page.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

Your withdrawal was paid

We paid out NGN 2,500.00. The payment provider confirmed it.

—
You get this email for each withdrawal from your balance.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

Your withdrawal didn’t go through

Your withdrawal of NGN 2,500.00 failed. The money is back in your balance, so you can try again.

Go to your dashboard: https://usetipme.xyz/dashboard?ml=dashboard

—
You get this email for each withdrawal from your balance.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz

A tip was refunded or disputed

The payment provider reported a refund or dispute on a tip you received. Our team is looking at it, and your TipMe balance hasn’t changed. We’ll contact you if we need anything.

—
You get this email when a tip you received is refunded or disputed.
Questions? support@usetipme.xyz
